AUTHOR: Saleh
TITLE: How to track and segment fish without human annotations: a self-supervised deep learning approach
REGION: South-east Queensland estuaries (Seagrass); tropical coastal Australia, 20 habitats (DeepFish); YouTube videos (global); Mediterranean (image dataset)
SPECIES: Class-agnostic fish segmentation; Seagrass dataset = Girella tricuspidata; DeepFish multi-species unlabelled; Mediterranean Fish Species 20 species used only for feature training
DATA: Public: Seagrass (4,280 frames, 9,429 annotations), DeepFish (~40k frames), YouTube-VOS fish subset (130 clips, 4,349 frames), Mediterranean Fish Species (~40k images, training only)
V_EV: Sec. 1: 'Evaluate our method on three public datasets with different image quality'; Sec. 5.1 per-dataset Table 1 and 'The latter is particularly challenging due to the difficulty of visually detecting the fish'
D2: 50/50 train/test within each video dataset; unit (frame vs. video) not stated
D_EV: Sec. 5: 'trained representation on 50% of the DeepFish, Seagrass, YouTube-VOS datasets ... We then evaluated it in the other 50% of the first three datasets' — split unit not specified
R_EV: Sec. 4.1: 'We train our feature extractor on all of the four datasets and evaluate it on the video datasets only' — every test dataset also contributes training data; no held-out external domain
C_EV: Sec. 4.4: 'to filter out predictions with low confidence, we use a threshold of 0.1' and 'binarise the output of the mask branch at the threshold of 0.5'; no FP-rate or uncertainty analysis (failure cases only qualitative, Fig. 11)
E_EV: Sec. 5.1: 'The average precision (AP), the average recall (AR), and intersection over union (IoU) were measured'; Table 1 reports APM/APL, ARM/ARL by object size; no counts or ecological variable
ARCH: Pseudo-labels from median background subtraction + RAFT optical flow; unsupervised refinement with DeepLabv3 + CRF historical moving average (MVA); SOLOv2 instance segmentation; rotated MBR boxes + SORT (Kalman + Hungarian) tracking; DeepUSPS saliency for still images
METR: COCO-style AP (APM, AP.50, AP.75, APL) and AR (ARM, ARL) for detection boxes and segmentation masks
NOTE: Segmentation-plus-tracking paper; tracking is shown only qualitatively (Fig. 7, videos), so TYPE = 분할 and all metrics are detection/segmentation AP/AR. V6 = P is a judgment call: per-dataset results are framed as 'different image quality' / 'robustness to different imaging conditions' but strata are datasets, not measured visibility; verifier may prefer V6 = N (V_ALL stays P). D1 = NR because the 50/50 split unit is not stated (authors claim 'generalising well to unseen videos' but do not say videos were the split unit). C_ALL = N: fixed 0.1 confidence threshold, no operating-point or FP analysis; limitations discussed only qualitatively. E4 = 크기별 reflects COCO medium/large AP, not fish body-size classes. PRE = NR: SOLOv2 backbone pretraining not stated (RAFT and DeepUSPS are off-the-shelf pretrained components). NIMG is approximate (4,280 + ~40,000 + 4,349 + ~40,000). Data availability statement says datasets are publicly available (they are third-party public datasets); no code link given.
